programs.name: Bookshop.org US media affiliate
programs.editorialFit: A focused first candidate for book anchors in evidence-backed pairs, with a storefront model that can support independent bookstores.
limitations: It does not replace a general merchant program for non-book companions, so pair recommendations must remain independently useful with ordinary links.
Attribution, compensation, onboarding, disclosure, and product availability must be rechecked against current terms before activation.
programs.nextGate: Review and explicitly accept the current affiliate terms, registered production site, allowed destination domain, Bookshop-issued tracking behavior, disclosure, and aggregate reporting boundary before activation; no paid link is live.

programs.name: Amazon Associates US
programs.editorialFit: A broad-catalog candidate that could cover books, games, golf accessories, and practical gifts without changing the editorial ranking.
limitations: The agreement and incorporated program policies can change, so every link format, registered site, disclosure, and content-use rule needs a fresh activation review.
A broad catalog can create commission bias; the recommendation order and ordinary manufacturer alternatives must remain unchanged when paid tracking is removed.
programs.nextGate: Lucas reviews and approves the current operating agreement before signup; after acceptance, exact product availability and Amazon-provided Special Links must be checked one recommendation at a time.

programs.name: Target Partners US
programs.editorialFit: A family-friendly US retailer alternative with a broad catalog and Impact-provided tracking can give readers a second exact-product destination without changing the recommendation order.
limitations: The official FAQ describes a seven-day last-click window, while the official homepage advertises commissions up to eight percent; exact rates and product eligibility remain program-controlled and must not be promised in articles.
Only exact products actually available at Target may receive links; near matches, marketplace substitutes, and commission differences cannot change editorial selection or product naming.
programs.nextGate: Retrieve and review the operative Target affiliate contract from Impact because the public pages expose program details but not the member agreement; acceptance, registered-site evidence, exact tracked links, disclosures, and reporting access remain separate activation gates.

programs.name: Walmart Creator US
programs.editorialFit: A second large US catalog could improve exact-product availability for practical gifts while the ordinary manufacturer link remains the stable editorial source and fallback.
limitations: Application eligibility currently requires majority age, US residence, an active Walmart or Sam's Club account, nonemployee status, and at least one public social account; payout readiness separately requires a US bank account and Impact identity verification.
Walmart controls qualifying products and may review each website or social placement; no link may be created until the exact item and supplied Qualifying Link are verified in an accepted account.

Member-only payout terms control live commission rates and attribution windows and may change without notice; activation must capture those terms and the required #WalmartPartner or paid-link disclosure.
programs.nextGate: Keep enrollment paused until Lucas approves applicant eligibility, public-social-account review, arbitration terms, and the exact Walmart disclosure pattern; after acceptance, separately capture current member payout terms, Impact identity verification, bank readiness, live commission rates, and attribution windows.

programs.name: eBay Partner Network US
programs.editorialFit: A marketplace contingency can help with discontinued or hard-to-find exact editions when a stable primary retailer is unavailable, without pretending a volatile listing is the canonical product source.
limitations: Listings, sellers, condition, shipping, and availability can change quickly, so an eBay destination needs a fresh exact-item check and should not replace a stable manufacturer or specialist link by default.

The current rate card describes a twenty-four-hour Buy It Now window, or a bid within twenty-four hours followed by a win within ten days; category rates may be low or zero and eBay can change terms on short notice.
Applicants must meet age and account-standing requirements, and every placement needs the current eBay disclosure rather than a generic assumption about marketplace links.
eBay classifies promotion through generative-AI tools as a special business model requiring prior written approval, so this AI-assisted publication cannot activate EPN without that written approval.
programs.nextGate: Before application, review the current network agreement, eligibility rules, and program-specific disclosure; after EPN account acceptance but before activation or promotional use, submit the AI Tools request from the registered email and obtain eBay's written approval for this AI-assisted promotion model.
